The '''T-65AC4 X-wing starfighter''' was an updated version of the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].

==Characteristics==
The T-65AC4 X-wing boasted many improvements over earlier models. It was much faster than the older T-65, with a sublight speed comparable to that of the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]. It was also capable of withstanding and causing significant damage, much more so than previous designs.<ref name="tjas" /> It was equipped with heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and more advanced [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] as well as an increased torpedo complement of eight compared to the six carried by older models.<ref name="sotg01" /> The T-65AC4 was also easier to fly thanks to a new cockpit layout and improved flight capabilities.<ref name="tjas" />

==History==
[[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] designed the T-65AC4 in response to newer starfighters entering service, such as the [[E-7 E-wing multi-role starfighter|E-wing escort starfighter]] and the [[A-9 Vigilance interceptor]]. Rather than allow the X-wing to fall into obsolescence, Incom decided to look at existing X-wing designs in order to find ways to upgrade many of the craft's systems.<ref name="sotg01" /> With all of the changes made, the new design was said to have very little in common with the X-wings of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="tjas" /> The new [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] remained popular with some of the galaxy's best pilots even during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and was still considered a dangerous craft.<ref name="sotg01" />
